newsitem.title: UK: Go-Ahead,VIA on UK rail shortlists.
newsitem.headline: Go-Ahead,VIA on UK rail shortlists.

text.p: British bus and train operator Go-Ahead Group said on Tuesday that its GOVIA joint venture with France's VIA-GTI has been shortlisted for ScotRail, one of Britain's forthcoming train operating company franchises.

In addition, GOVIA is the major partner in a joint venture, formed with an existing management group, bidding for the Regional Railways North East franchise. This venture, called Northstar Pennine Ltd, has been shortlisted to tender for that line, the British company said.

Go-Ahead made the announcement in a statement, taking advantage of new guidelines from the Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) which allow bidding companies to disclose when they have been shortlisted for upcoming rail contracts.
GOVIA is also shortlisted to operate the Docklands Light Railway in London.
About half of the 25 train operating companies in England and Wales have already been awarded, and Go-Ahead has won the Thames Trains franchise in tandem with existing management.
Last week, the Office of Fair Trading said it would invite opinions for a possible review under competition regulations of Go-Ahead's Thames Trains deal.
